notes:
Inbound via self-serve signup; converted to AE handoff after spike metrics looked promising. Founder (Tara Lim) on call: 'We need streaming that feels instant in-app; users drop if there's a long stream delay.' Key themes: latency-first, tight budget, short POC.

Model preferences: prefer smaller open models (quantized) for main route; plan to keep a higher-quality fallback for complex support queries. Interested in token-level cost breakdown for routing decisions.

Security: customer will be on public cloud for now (multi-tenant), but needs SSO/SAML and audit logs. Data residency not required at this stage. SOC2 is a procurement blocker — legal asked for evidence but engineering ok to proceed with POC under NDA.

Quote from dev lead: 'If p95 latency for streaming (end-to-end) <250ms we can ship this month.' Cost sensitivity: aiming to keep hosted inference spend under $3k/mo during POC.

POC plan: 2-week spike using Hosted API streaming endpoints -> integrate SDK into React native in-app chat -> run 10k messages load test + p95 latency sweep -> evaluate quality/regressions with short eval prompt set.

Stated wins needed to move to procurement: 1) consistent streaming latency (p95) measured in our app; 2) clear fallback routing behavior for busy periods; 3) simple billing/usage visibility for token spend.
